paraphrase: Six independent finite constructive certificates: delete any one of inhabitedness, well-foundedness, universal contingent dependence, or all-actual-contingency from the four-member inconsistent core and find a satisfying alternative; replacing a concrete predecessor by a present abstract one also defeats the necessary-concrete inference; and a necessary actual bearer need not exist in worlds inaccessible from the actual world. All models use complete-history worlds and rigid identity.
